name: io.github.tonyyang0504/banggood_dropship-mcp
description: Banggood Dropship Center (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shipping, get_

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: app_id issued by the Banggood Open Platform (https://api.banggood.com, Manager Center) after the partner application is approved; calls must come from the registered IP address.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app_secret. GET /getAccessToken?app_id=&app_secret= returns an access_token valid 2 hours, sent as the access_token query parameter and renewed automatically.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_WAREHOUSE
environmentVariables.description: Banggood warehouse code for quote_shipping (the `warehouse` of GetProductInfo's warehouse_list, e.g. CN, US, UK); the API rejects the call (12031) when it is missing.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency for prices and shipping fees (e.g. USD); Banggood uses USD when unset.
